_comment: Re-run history in the shape the GitHub Actions API supplies it:
runs -> attempts -> jobs -> which tests failed in each attempt.
In production this is fetched from /runs/{id}/attempts/{n} and cached.
Here it is a file so the demo is deterministic and offline.
The 'log' field binds a run to the log it produced; in production the
failure record already carries its job id.
